description: Search YouTube by keyword for videos, Shorts, channels, playlists, or movies. Filter by upload date, duration, sort order, features, market, and language. Optional video details add exact publish dates, views, likes, categories, and tags.

duration.description: Filter videos by length. Applies to video and Shorts searches.
duration.title: Duration

features.description: Filter videos by features. Multiple selections are combined. Legacy aliases cc, location, and purchased are accepted for saved tasks; cc maps to subtitles and the other two are ignored with a warning.
features.title: Video Features

includeVideoDetails.description: Fetch each video's public detail payload to add exact publish date, views, likes, category, tags, and full description. Adds one request per video and makes runs slower.
includeVideoDetails.title: Include Video Details

language.description: Language for YouTube labels and search text (hl). Auto follows the selected market.
language.title: Interface Language

market.description: Country used for YouTube's search context (gl). Results and labels follow this market.
market.title: Market

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results per query. YouTube may serve fewer rows for a given query, entity type, session, or IP; the run reports the requested and actual counts and whether the result pool was exhausted.
maxResults.title: Max Results Per Query

scrapeAllResults.description: Keep loading pages until YouTube stops offering results. This ignores Max Results Per Query and can take longer on broad searches.
scrapeAllResults.title: Scrape All Available Results

searchQueries.description: One or more YouTube search terms. Each query is scraped separately and its results are combined in the dataset.
searchQueries.title: Search Queries

sortBy.description: Order of the search results. YouTube currently supports relevance and popularity (view count). Legacy values upload_date and rating are accepted for saved tasks and mapped to relevance with a warning.
sortBy.title: Sort By

type.description: Restrict results to one entity type. Legacy plural value shorts is accepted and mapped to Shorts.
type.title: Result Type

uploadDate.description: Only return results uploaded in the selected period. Applies to videos and Shorts.
uploadDate.title: Upload Date

title: YouTube Search Scraper Input
